Shared fields (name, version, description, author, license, keywords) come from .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Never put test credentials or reviewer instructions here: the portal's Review details form takes them.

interface.longDescription:
Create mind maps, flowcharts, project plans and smart boards as editable slates. Slatebox draws them as real notes and lines on a shared canvas and returns a link that your team can open and edit together.

With Slatebox you can:
- draw a mind map, a flowchart or a Gantt-chart project plan from a description or from Mermaid
- read a slate, summarise it, and get it back as Mermaid
- add boards such as a pipeline, hiring plan or launch plan, with rules that hold when cards move
- restyle a slate's presentation, which plays on the live canvas
- ask the Slatebox agent to work on a slate in the open, with removals held for a person

Every call acts as you and reaches only the slates you can open. Changes that remove or overwrite work ask for your confirmation first.
defaultPrompt: Make a mind map of our Q1 launch ideas
Turn these steps into a flowchart
Draft a six-week hiring plan as a Gantt chart

positive.prompt: Make a mind map of ideas for our team offsite.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new slate holding a mind map with a root and several branches of offsite ideas, and replies with the slate link.

positive.description: Flowchart from a chain of steps
positive.prompt: Flowchart this: request, manager review, finance approval, paid.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new slate with four connected notes in order (Request, Manager review, Finance approval, Paid) and replies with the slate link.

positive.description: Project plan as a Gantt chart
positive.prompt: Draft a six-week hiring plan for two engineers as a Gantt chart.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new slate with a Gantt plan of phases and tasks spanning about six weeks, and replies with the dates and the slate link.

positive.prompt: Make this something my team can edit: graph TD; A-->B; B-->C
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new slate with three notes (A, B, C) joined by two lines, and replies with the slate link.

positive.prompt: Summarise the slate at https://app.slatebox.com/canvas/DEMO_SHARE_ID and give it to me as Mermaid.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short summary of the demo slate and its Mermaid text in a code block, and makes no changes.

negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a product manager job.

publication.release_notes: First release: mind maps, flowcharts, project plans, smart boards, slate summaries, presentations and the Slatebox agent.
